opportunity.title: Short-Form Video Content Creation Package
opportunity.target_customer: Small businesses and content creators looking to enhance their online presence
opportunity.customer_problem: Struggling to create engaging short-form video content that captures attention and promotes products/services effectively on platforms like TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
opportunity.proposed_solution: Offer a complete package that includes content strategy, scriptwriting, video editing, and social media captions tailored for short-form video platforms to help small businesses and content creators establish a compelling digital presence.
deliverables: 5 short-form video scripts (up to 60 seconds each)
5 edited video clips with branding and effects
5 engaging captions optimized for different platforms
Content strategy guide for posting schedule and engagement tips
opportunity.next_action: Create a portfolio or samples of past work to showcase capabilities.
